item.title: 90-year-old woman dies after being hit by car in Millbrae
item.description: A 90-year-old woman was struck and killed by a vehicle in Millbrae on Monday.San Mateo County Sheriff’s Office deputies responded just before 3 p.m. to the 500 block of Richmond Drive on reports of a vehicle striking a pedestrian, according to a department statement.Deputies found the woman suffering from "serious injuries" at the scene, and medics took her to a hospital where she died that evening.Her name was not released.The SMCSO Major Accident Investigation Team is investigating the crash.

item.title: 'Heartbroken': Famed California bald eagles lose eggs to ravens raid
item.description: Jackie and Shadow, the famous eagles of Big Bear Valley in the San Bernardino National Forest, were robbed of their eggs on Friday, only days after the mother bird laid her second egg.
